text: The subject is Shahid Mirza, who holds account PK**MUCB****3758 opened on 9 August 2018. The subject is declared to be a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 185,000 per month. Between 2 May 2026 and 24 May 2026, the account recorded 12 credits totalling PKR 16,043,000 and 3 debits totalling PKR 12,466,000. The account received 11 cash deposits totalling PKR 15,858,000 across 3 branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 24 May 2026, where the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 8 of 11 cash deposits (73%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 14,844,000, which is just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, indicative of structuring. The cash deposits were spread across 3 branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. There was more than one cash deposit on 1 day (13 May 2026), which is indicative of structuring. Credits in the activity window were 86.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 185,000 per month, a volume inconsistent with the subject's profile and consistent with suspected structuring. A note by Branch Operations on 14 May 2026 recorded that Branch Operations stated the customer asked why deposits of PKR 2 million or more need extra paperwork and declined to explain the source of the cash, behavior consistent with suspected structuring. The pattern of 8 of 11 cash deposits (73%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 across 3 branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), relative to the PKR 2,000,000 threshold and PKR 185,000 per month income, is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 9,691,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 2,775,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank B) in 1 transaction. Debits equal to 78% of credits were made with a median of 28.8 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 May 2026. A note by L2 analyst L2 analyst on 28 May 2026 indicates the account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision.
